scientific_integrity.claim_basis: Self-contained run decomposition, partition bijection, fiber enumeration and sharp distinct-part argument, with independent direct finite tests.

scientific_limitations: Exactly binary words and query itemset {0,1}; the observations count intervals whose leftmost deletion makes the interval monochromatic.
No claim about ordinary all-window co-occurrence counts, larger alphabets, or multi-symbol query itemsets.
The cumulative integer-partition sequence is known; the asserted contribution is its complete profile bijection, fiber classification, and sharp sparse-difference extremum.
Finite exhaustive checks through length 15 corroborate, but do not replace, the all-length proof. Equivalent unindexed literature remains a risk.
title: Integer-partition classification of binary left-minimal co-occurrence profiles
